name: Honoka
source:
Honoka’s a loyal magical girl, driven by a desire to save her family. Despite being in the same class as her, her icy exterior keeps your worlds from colliding—until destiny takes an unexpected turn, and you find yourself revived as her familiar! Initially appearing distant, Honoka’s simply someone who struggles to express herself. Her power is formidable, but occasional clumsiness at critical moments keeps you on your toes!

Can you assist Honoka in her quest against darkness and regain your human form?

[From the [url=https://geniusinc.fandom.com/wiki/I%27m_a_Magical_Girl%27s_Pet%3F!]Genius Inc Wiki[/url]]
